messages:
Maya: quick cross-team check — planning an instrumentation rollup for token-cost attribution + per-route latency heatmap. Proposed milestones: 1) event schema v1.2 (contract + docs), 2) infra exposes route-level p50/p95/p99 + token counters, 3) canary (2 tenants) + dashboard, 4) full roll. Owners I think: Maya (analytics), Liam (ingest infra), Jen (runtime). Can everyone ack and call out blockers? I'll open schema PR today: https://github.com/redwood/instr/pulls/1234

Sam: ack. I'll review schema PR. One q: do we standardize on event field name `token_cost.usd` vs `cost_token_usd`? prefer `token_cost_usd` to avoid dot nesting.

Jen: I can add runtime hooks — estimate 3 days. Need a flag for safe-failover (runtime fallback to legacy counter). Will add feature flag config, pinging @ops-bot for rollout window.

Liam: infra note — to surface per-route latency we'll need an ingestion change (route_id tag) + a small tracer patch. Blocking: analytics ingestion team must accept new route tag; ETA for pipeline change ~ 1 week. JIRA: INSTR-451. Also need retention spec -> how long to keep per-route token counters?

Maya: retention: 90 days for detailed, 365 aggregated. Milestone dates: schema PR by Mon (Mar 25), infra change by Mar 31, canary Apr 5-7. If that works, Jen + Liam coordinate next steps.

Sam: I'll open a follow-up PR to rename keys if we decide. Also adding smoke test harness (local).

ops-bot: deploybot: canary window requested Apr 5 02:00-06:00 UTC — awaiting approval. :rocket:

analytics-bot: smoke-tests: local-run OK, ingest schema validation passed (0 violations). CPU delta +0.2% on canary config.

Jen: I'll own the canary dashboard: will add p95 by route + token breakdown. tagging @Maya for acceptance criteria.

Maya: thanks — calling out final action items: Sam open rename PR, Liam open INSTR-451 subtask for tracer, Jen add feature flag + dash, I'll publish schema PR and docs. Please ack with :thumbsup: if you can take these.

Sam: :thumbsup:
Jen: :thumbsup:
Liam: :thumbsup:
